NFL DFS Defense Rankings: Week 7 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 25 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 25, 10:22 AM ET

The Texans are the top-projected defense on the Week 7 DraftKings main slate at 8.4 DraftKings points for $3,400, against the Giants. Broncos (7.2, $3,300) and Vikings (7.2, $3,500) are next.

The Dolphins return the most per dollar among defenses projected for at least 6 points: 2.61 projected points per $1,000 at $2,300.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 25, 10:22 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Defenses to know in Week 7

Texans, HOU vs NYG ($3,400)

Texans carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 8.4 DraftKings points at $3,400. That is 1.3 points clear of Broncos. The salary works out to 2.49 projected points per $1,000, 3rd of 8 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Texans averaged 8.6 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 15.3, and it holds 10% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Houston is a 10.5-point favorite at home against the Giants, with an implied team total of 26.5 in a game totaled at 42.5.

Value: Dolphins, MIA at NYJ ($2,300)

Dolphins projects for 6.0 DraftKings points at $2,300, which works out to 2.61 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 8 defenses the model projects for 6 or more points. Across 10,000 simulations Dolphins averaged 6.1 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 14.1, and it holds 9% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Miami is a 3.5-point underdog on the road against the Jets, with an implied team total of 18 in a game totaled at 39.5.
